subject: Question about my membership plan after store visit
body: Hi, I'm writing about something that happened at the Shenzhen Nanshan store and I'm not sure what my options are. I signed up for a membership plan there a while back, and when I went in last week to ask about it, the staff told me the terms had changed and that my plan might not be covered the way I thought. I don't have the original paperwork in front of me right now, so I can't quote exactly what it said, but I remember being told at signup that the plan included certain services for the length of the term. The person I spoke to was polite but couldn't confirm whether my situation falls under any kind of warranty or protection, and suggested I contact someone else, though I wasn't given a clear next step. I'd like to understand whether my plan is still valid as originally described, and if not, what happened to it. I'm not trying to make a fuss, I just want to know where I stand before I decide what to do. Thanks for any help you can give.
